response.original_title: Goopy Gooey Stops A Robot And Saves Christmas
response.overview: When Christmas is in danger because of a robot that wants to destroy the holiday the silly but nice Goopy Gooey becomes the worlds most unexpected hero. With ideas sticky gadgets and support, from his true friends Goopy goes on a quick adventure to stop the robot before it ruins Christmas for everyone.  On the way Goopy discovers that being brave doesn't mean being the strongest—it means not stopping when others are waiting for you. Full of scenes, exciting fights and warm holiday feelings Goopy Gooey Stops A Robot And Saves Christmas is an enjoyable family adventure that shows the power of friendship the value of courage and the wonder of believing that even the silliest hero can make a difference.
